Evidence & scope

Current provider documentation received separate author, source-verifier and adversarial AI content reviews for the exact imported observations. Data Studio explicitly offers NLP annotation software with configurable project interfaces, automation and quality workflows. The broader private model and agent deployment offer is recorded as context, not a second supplier category or proof of data delivery. Separate author, source-verifier and adversarial AI source-content reviews are complete for the exact imported observations. Actual full/partial/unread source scopes are retained; no operational audit, commercial quality endorsement or automatic review of mentioned benchmarks is implied.
